app.title: Dot Race
app.subtitle: Vector Rally — turn-based racing on the grid
lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.practiceHint: Riding solo? Start a practice race or invite friends to join
game.timedHint: Move whenever you're ready — first across the line wins!
game.tapHint: Use the arrows or tap a highlighted square on the map
game.grassPenaltyTurns: Grass cut — max gear 1 for the penalty
game.penaltyBody: Penalty — you can't move until the countdown reaches zero.
game.crashBody: You hit another car — momentum lost.
howto.title: How to play
howto.1.title: Goal
howto.1.body: Complete the laps and cross the finish line first. The top three make the podium.
howto.2.title: Starting grid
howto.2.body: Every driver rolls two dice; the highest roll starts up front.
howto.3.title: Momentum movement
howto.3.body: Your car keeps last turn's velocity. Each turn you adjust it by ±1 per axis: use the arrows below the map or tap a highlighted square.
howto.4.title: Gears
howto.4.body: Your speed is your gear (max 6) — the gauge on the map corner shows it. You can only change by 1 per turn, so brake before corners!
howto.5.title: Off track
howto.5.body: Landed on the green? Your car stops (gear 0) and you can only move 1 square per turn until you're back on track. Cutting through grass costs extra: 3 rounds at max gear 1 the first time, 5 rounds after that. In timed mode: 5 seconds stopped, then 10 seconds and gear 0 on repeat cuts.
howto.6.title: Rumble strips
howto.6.body: Red and white kerbs sit on the grass at corners — clip them and your phone buzzes to warn you you're at the edge.
howto.7.title: Finish
howto.7.body: Go all the way around the circuit and cross the orange stripe to close a lap. Complete every lap to finish the race.
